object: fixed D431 ExtraTrees selector structural cost
question: What is the exact tree-path lower bound of the nonlinear B3M predictor before feature extraction and judge charging?
number: The fixed 256-tree depth-6 D431 forest has 25,604 total nodes and 25,348 non-root structural nodes. Across 60 fresh D432/D433 rows it visits 1,394..1,536 non-root nodes per prediction (mean 1,495.3166666667), plus 256 accumulator updates and 256 feature bits whose extraction is separate. This is an exact structural lower bound only; safe score gain remains 0.
